context_requirements: A specific transferase enzyme must be expressed and rate-limiting in the assayed cell line.
The drug must engage its transferase target at 10 micromolar with sufficient selectivity to produce a transcriptional signature.
The affected transferase pathway must feed into transcriptional regulation within 6-24 hours.
falsifiers: A reproducible, concentration-dependent transcriptional signature shared across multiple cell lines at 6 h or 24 h would contradict the prediction of no class-level response.

Selective modulation of a known transferase-dependent transcriptional program (e.g., cholesterol synthesis, one-carbon metabolism, polyamine synthesis) would indicate a specific transferase subfamily is active.
Line-selective responses tracking expression of a particular transferase would falsify the blanket 'none' prediction.
